artifactDescriptor.normalizationRule: Before authority resolution, normalize artifact frontmatter, a sidecar manifest or another durable machine-readable record to this descriptor. A candidate missing any required field is not authoritative.
artifactDescriptor.pathRule: path identifies the artifact within the current project or tool context; basename alone never defines role.
artifactDescriptor.provenanceRule: provenance should identify approval, acceptance or explicit user designation when that evidence is required by the artifact role.

authorityDomains.scope: Confirmed audience, business outcome, capabilities, constraints, proof, terminology and settled product facts. Neither skill may silently rewrite these facts to satisfy its own output.

Researched or explicitly confirmed audience facts, situations, jobs, motivations, objections, decision criteria and vocabulary, with evidence, confidence and provenance. Hypotheses and simulated persona reactions remain separate review evidence.
Offer, positioning, persuasion strategy, claims, authoritative commercial copy and the constraints attached to that copy.
Visual direction, design implementation, rendered evaluation, accepted visual-system output and design-side surface coordination.

artifactRoles.whenOwnerAbsent: Use confirmed project or user product truth. Missing facts stay unresolved; neither skill may invent them.
Normalize existing PRODUCT.md audience facts with their evidence; no new file is required. Unknowns and hypotheses stay unresolved. Simulated reactions cannot supply missing research or confirmation.
Design Studio remains fully usable with user-supplied or repository copy and its local surface-copy coordination rules. That fallback does not claim Growth Arsenal methodology or strategy authority.
Growth Arsenal remains fully usable without Design Studio. It may format its own reports, but those internal presentation assets do not become project visual-design authority.

precedence.modeRule: For preserve-world work, accepted project DESIGN.md governs visual decisions. For greenfield or explicit redesign work, the selected direction governs active visual choices while retained product and brand commitments still apply.

conflicts.effect: Record the contradiction as stale or unresolved audience evidence and return it to the user. Simulated personas and audience hypotheses cannot rewrite confirmed product facts.
Mark the conflicting offer/copy artifact stale or unresolved and return the contradiction to the copy authority or user. Never change confirmed facts to fit copy.
Mark affected offer/copy claims and visual assumptions stale. Revalidate dependent artifacts before acceptance.

Design Studio may adapt composition within accepted visual authority, but it must not silently truncate, weaken or rewrite strategic copy. If the trade-off cannot be satisfied in both domains, return it to the copy authority or user.

Growth Arsenal decides authoritative wording and claims; Design Studio decides visual expression. A cross-domain decision with no compatible solution remains unresolved for the user rather than being won by prompt order.
Apply the role/scope/provenance resolution order. If more than one candidate still has equal authority, halt the dependent decision and request an explicit designation instead of guessing.

invalidates: offer/copy and visual assumptions that depend on superseded audience evidence
offer-copy assumptions that depend on the changed fact
visual assumptions that depend on the changed fact
surface briefs and layouts that depend on superseded wording
preserves: accepted visual system unless the user explicitly reopens it

stalenessRules.pendingRule: Candidate, staged, rejected, preserve, none and rolled-back transitions invalidate nothing. New profiled authority requires a verified publication receipt; historical accepted systems retain their recorded evidence.
invalidates: surface-specific visual assumptions tied to the superseded system

compositionReadiness.requirementRule: Strategy-sensitive website work requires product truth, audience context, offer-positioning and commercial-copy. Accepted-design-system input also requires current visual-design authority. Other facets are not-applicable, not implicitly ready.
compositionReadiness.provenanceRule: The readiness profile uses the existing provenance object: project, immutable role-scoped revision, evidence [{kind, ref}], dependencies [{facet, path, revision}], optional facets for offer-copy and audience entries [{category, text, kind, confidence, evidence}]. Hosts resolve and verify evidence before normalization; a string, producer name or claimed state alone is not proof.
compositionReadiness.audienceRule: At least one researched or explicitly confirmed entry with matching evidence is required for audience authority. Preserve hypotheses and simulations separately and list categories without facts as unresolved. Approval never upgrades a simulated statement without separate research or user confirmation.
compositionReadiness.offerCopyRule: Declare offer-positioning and/or commercial-copy in provenance.facets. Approval of an offer alone does not approve its commercial copy; one approved artifact may explicitly cover both facets.
compositionReadiness.dependencyRule: Record all source revisions used to approve each artifact. Resolve dependencies by facet, path and revision, never mtime. A missing, changed, stale or ambiguous dependency makes dependent authority stale; cycles are stale. A combined offer/copy export may pin its own offer facet as an internal copy dependency. Stale sources retain their evidence but not current authority. Unrelated authority remains intact.
compositionReadiness.selectionRule: Candidates require declared role, project scope, matching project, supported state, revision and authority evidence. Equal-authority candidates remain conflicting unless current user-designation evidence selects an exact facet/path/revision. Neither producer nor input order breaks ties.
compositionReadiness.receiptRule: validate_design_intent derives composition.readiness from the supplied snapshot, checks compositionState, and rejects a supplied readiness receipt that differs. Existing intents without composition remain classification-only records, not evidence that website inputs are ready.
compositionReadiness.handoffRule: Ready facets require no action. Conflicts return to the user. Missing or stale offer/copy and audience inputs may request a public growth-arsenal artifact when available; otherwise request confirmed supplied inputs. No skill is invoked and no adjacent internal method is read.

integrationRules: Design Studio consumes compatible approved offer/copy artifacts by declared role, project scope and approval evidence; it does not invoke, copy or reimplement Growth Arsenal internal methods.
Growth Arsenal remains independently usable and is not expected to duplicate Design Studio visual direction, implementation or rendered-evaluation methods.

A Growth Arsenal repository-internal DESIGN.md or token file is report/tooling presentation state unless it is explicitly exported as project visual-design authority and accepted by Design Studio or the user.
Skill installation order, prompt order, filename alone and file modification time never create authority.
